summary: Full backend + frontend regression testing for SI FOUR AM. 19/19 backend pytest tests pass covering auth (login/wrong-pw/me), role guards (rider vs barteam vs superadmin on rider-stock, deposits, finance, invoices), menus (9 items ordered, cost>0), inventory tx (in/out/opname), menu-stock produce (increments menu stock, decrements recipe materials + packaging), rider-stock upsert (no duplicate; delta decrements central menu stock), POS sales (receipt_no S4-YYYYMMDD-NNNN, remaining decremented, overstock=400, customer saved with points, EOD summary), attendance (wrong-pin 401, duplicate 409, checkout), deposit (correct diff/minus/net_cash/motivation formula + upsert), invoice (INV- format, subtotal-discount=total), dashboard/salary tiers (4)/expenses/handovers. Frontend Playwright: superadmin login shows sidebar with Main/RiderStock/Deposit/Handover/More; theme toggle flips dark/light; rider ricky lands on /pos, PIN gate accepts pin-key-9/6/2/0 and unlocks POS with 9 products; barteam login → /deposit shows deposit-rider-select, calc-net-cash, deposit-save-button, 9 deposit-cash-<menuId> selects; /rider-stock page loads with rider-stock-total and rider-stock-save-button; Settings lang-id switches labels to Bahasa Indonesia.

issues: React warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key, 9' emitted many times. Likely a list rendered with `key={m.order}` (menus have order 1..9, but somewhere the value 9 is duplicated) or key=index conflict. Not a functional bug but should be fixed by using stable unique ids (e.g. `key={m.id}`).

action_items: Fix React duplicate-key warning (key=9). Search for map calls in POS/RiderStock/Deposit/Invoice using `key={...order}` or `key={i}` and switch to `key={item.id}` for uniqueness.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~960 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, inventory, sales, deposits, finance).
CORSMiddleware is added AFTER app.include_router — works with Starlette but standard practice is add middleware before include_router.
login_attempts lockout keyed by client.host+identifier: behind an ingress this may become a shared IP; consider trusting X-Forwarded-For or scoping only by identifier.
produce endpoint decrements ALL packaging materials by qty each time, not only those in recipe — intentional? If recipe already lists packaging, this may double-deduct.
Deposit.net_cash uses cash - expenses + debt_payment (spec matches). Note: debt_payment does not reduce cash physically; consider clarifying UI wording.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows pass; one non-blocking React key warning)

seed_data_creation: Tests use TEST_DATE = today-7 and TEST_ prefixed customer/notes. No prod data modified.
